notes.title: Sunny Day Jack is Headed to Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[url=bit.ly/SDJ_Kickstarter][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FepF8o9XkAUqXKM?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img][/url]
[h1]
[url=bit.ly/SDJ_Kickstarter]Something's Wrong With Sunny Day Jack is Headed to Kickstarter from Thursday, October 13, 2022 to Saturday, November 12, 2022![/url][/h1]

We're crowdfunding the project in order to speed up the development of this horror eroge, and with your help we hope to raise a minimum of USD$26,000 to bring the game to fruition. Our stretch goals include additional slice-of-life scenes, an alternate story mode, translations and dubs, and even another route. Along with that, our campaign contains a number of limited edition and limited quantity merchandise exclusive to the Kickstarter by our partners at [url=https://www.loadingcrewcrafts.com/]Loading Crew Crafts[/url].

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/887/332/bee02e9133f2bc56a100c5033572c57d_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=680&fit=max&v=1665602423&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=da429a505db70cd92a12cb438e9c54e7[/img]

Within the first 24 hours of the campaign, you can even snag some of our Early Bird tiers at $30 and $55.
We hope to see you there!
